qc_policy: THE PRODUCT PUBLISHES NO PER-SAMPLE QUALITY FLAG — the daily files carry no `*_qc` variable at all (measured 2026-09-18 on ESACCI-SEASTATE-L3-SWH-MULTI_1D-20150101-fv01.nc, whose variables are time, lat, lon, swh, swh_adjusted, swh_denoised, swh_uncertainty, bathymetry, distance_to_coast, satellite, cycle, relative_pass). The L2P-to-L3 processor edits upstream, so every kept row carries qc 1 and the store says so rather than inventing a grade; `swh_uncertainty` is the per-sample number closest to one and is a CHANNEL. A row is kept when its time and position are present and at least one of `swh` / `swh_denoised` is; a value outside its channel's bounds becomes NaN for that channel alone and is counted, never clipped. The mission is the `platform` (from the file's own flag_meanings), so a consumer can hold out an altimeter the way it holds out a year.
